text: Greedy bishop pushes in the Ruy Lopez get trapped on b3 every time In the Spanish opening, White's light-squared bishop on b3 seems powerful. Black plays a6, b5, and c4, locking the bishop in a wooden box with no escape. The defense: White must preserve an escape route with a4 or c3 before pushing the d-pawn.
